newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Great Eastern, Merevale wins land tender.
newsitem.headline: Great Eastern, Merevale wins land tender.

text.p: Singapore's Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) said on Wednesday Great Eastern Life Assurance Company Ltd and Merevale Holdings Pte Ltd had won its tender for China Square with a bid of Singapore $340.05 million.
The 13,554 sq m China Square G site is near the central business district and was sold on a 99-year lease, a company statement said.
The land would be used for residential and commercial development, including a hotel and a medical centre.
The tender was issued on February 27 1997 and closed on May 14 1997.
